Using your editor

  1. To add a line break hold Shif and hit Return instead of just hitting Return. Hitting Retrun will place a paragraph with a larger space before and after it.
  2. Email tags: To insert First Name, Last Name, Meeting Date, and Meeting Title click the icons FN, LN, MD, MT or type {firstname}, {lastname}, {meetingdate} and {metingtitle} respectly.
